## Site Overview
Veloura.ai is an AI companion and creative platform for adults (18+). It offers uncensored AI chat, AI image generation, AI video creation, voice cloning, and LoRA model training — all without content restrictions.

## Primary Use Cases
- AI girlfriend / AI boyfriend chat with persistent memory and no content filters
- Uncensored NSFW AI image generation from text prompts
- AI video generation (deepfakes, kissing videos, motion transfer)
- Voice cloning and AI audio tools (text-to-speech, song generation, sound effects)
- Custom LoRA model training for consistent AI character generation
- AI image editing (face swap, background removal, cloth swap, upscaling)

## Content Policy
All content on Veloura.ai is AI-generated and entirely fictional. No real persons are depicted. The platform is restricted to adults aged 18 and over.

## Technology
- Built with Next.js (App Router), React, Prisma, PostgreSQL
- Hosted on Cloudflare infrastructure
- AI models: Stable Diffusion, Flux, WAN 2.2, ModelsLab API
